questions.stem: Which of the following correctly compares a property of triglycerides and polysaccharides?

options.text: Triglycerides are insoluble in water, while glycogen is soluble
Triglycerides are polymers, while polysaccharides are not
Both are formed by hydrolysis reactions
Triglycerides contain ester bonds, while polysaccharides contain glycosidic bonds

questions.explanation: Triglycerides are formed when fatty acids bond to glycerol via ester bonds, while polysaccharides such as starch and glycogen are formed when monosaccharides are joined by glycosidic bonds. Both types of bond are formed by condensation reactions.
